note: Oman: foreign artists and cultural professionals come on the cultural visa. The Royal Oman Police's own visa list names it among resident sponsored visas, granted by the competent authority on its request and under its responsibility to foreigners visiting for cultural purposes, for one, five or ten years, renewable for the same. That it lets them live and work temporarily in arts and culture, from November 2025, at 50 rials a year, sponsored by a host such as the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Youth and activated within three months of issue, rests on a newspaper's report of the Royal Oman Police's decision. GCC citizens' position isn't modelled apart.

sources.title: Gulf News, Oman unveils cultural visa to attract global talent (November 2025)
sources.said: has announced the introduction of a cultural visa scheme, with the aim of providing clear legal avenues for foreign nationals to reside and work temporarily within its borders in the fields of arts and culture.
